blocks.x: Exceptions auto-resolved at 74% — control tower to agentic remediation
A global 3PL (40+ countries) — Logistics & Supply Chain engagement delivered by a 19-person team over 14 months, Global scope, commercial model: outcome-linked.

items: Visibility stitched from carrier portals; ETAs updated by phone.
Exception queues consumed 60% of ops capacity.

blocks.x: The event spine unified TMS/WMS/telematics/carrier events on Forge; Nexus decision policies route exceptions; Swarm agents remediate the recoverable classes (document mismatches, rebookings, detention claims) within policy. Carrier identity verification closed the fraud vector.

The program ran through the Achala Method: a Value Mapping Sprint locked the baseline, a gated PoC produced the capital-grade evidence, and production hardening (replay, SLOs, control tests) was generated by the delivery itself rather than reconstructed for audit.

items: Trial eligibility matching at 10x — enrollment windows met
EUDR due-diligence automated — compliance evidence in hours, premium channels opened

blocks.x: Towers: Agentic AI & Hyperautomation, Data, Analytics & Lakehouse, Cybersecurity & Zero-Trust. Platforms: Achala Swarm, Achala Nexus, Achala Forge.

items: the platform configuration patterns and the operator enablement curriculum, refined across engagements of this type.
organizational absorption: adoption paths are designed for each client's operating culture, never assumed.

blocks.x: Client identity withheld under confidentiality. Metrics are reported against the baseline locked in the Diagnose phase; measurement method available under NDA.
